Package com.signalwire.sdk.rest.namespaces

Class CallingNamespace

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.rest.namespaces.CallingNamespace
public class CallingNamespace extends Object
REST-based call control. All commands are dispatched as POST /api/calling/calls with a "command" field that names the operation, optionally an "id" field that names the target call, and a "params" object containing keyword arguments. The mock server (and the real Calling API) matches commands against the registered routes via the command field.
